starterCode:
# 美食喜好台
food = 1   # 食物
like = 1   # 1 喜欢 0 不喜欢

hide()
word = "apples"
cn = "苹果"
plural = "可数名词：可以加 s"
emo = "🍎"
if food == 2:
    word = "rice"
    cn = "米饭"
    plural = "不可数名词：不能加 s"
    emo = "🍚"
if food == 3:
    word = "milk"
    cn = "牛奶"
    plural = "不可数名词：不能加 s"
    emo = "🥛"
if food == 4:
    word = "noodles"
    cn = "面条"
    plural = "习惯用复数"
    emo = "🍜"
sent = "I like " + word + "."
if like == 0:
    sent = "I don't like " + word + "."
fill_rect(0, 130, 340, 32, "#16a34a")
write(emo + " " + word + "（" + cn + "）", 0, 130, "#fff", 14)
fill_rect(0, 76, 340, 40, "#fef3c7")
write(sent, 0, 76, "#b45309", 14)
fill_rect(0, 20, 340, 44, "#f1f5f9")
write("单词说明：" + plural, 0, 20, "#0f172a", 10)
write("问答：Do you like apples? — Yes, I do. / No, I don't.", -10, -30, "#1d4ed8", 10)
write("食物单词：apple rice milk noodles bread egg fish juice", -10, -60, "#7c3aed", 10)

sections.title: 食物单词
sections.body:
【apple 苹果 · bread 面包 · rice 米饭 · milk 牛奶 · egg 鸡蛋 · fish 鱼 · noodles 面条 · juice 果汁】
可数：apple(s)、egg(s)——有单复数。
不可数：rice、milk、bread、juice——永远不加 s，说 some rice。

sections.title: like 句型
sections.body:
【肯定：I like apples.（喜欢的一类用复数）】
【否定：I don't like noodles.（don't = do not）】
【问答：Do you like milk? —Yes, I do. / No, I don't.】
第三人称：She likes apples.（注意 likes）

sections.title: 可数与不可数
sections.body:
【可数名词：一个一个数得清（an apple → two apples）】
【不可数名词：没法数个数（rice, milk, water, bread）】
不可数要量化得借量词：a glass of milk、two bowls of rice。
口诀：能数加 s，不能数用 some。

examples.q: Do you like juice? 怎么回答？
steps: juice 不可数不影响回答
